dataSources.name: NLR anonymized Eagle GPU job traces
NLR Eagle GPU node iLO metrics

cleaningAndTime.jobAndMeterTimestamps: Parsed as timezone-aware UTC; offsets represented in each UTC day window.
cleaningAndTime.meterUnits: Source iLO vl is instantaneous whole-node watts; scenario power is MW; CSV observed daily statistics are kW.
cleaningAndTime.meterCleaning: Reject non-numeric, non-finite, or negative W; retain zero; average duplicate node/timestamp rows; require all 96 fixed 15-minute UTC bins; no interpolation.
cleaningAndTime.jobCleaning: Completed GPU-partition records using exactly one sampled node; source job must start, submit, and end on one UTC date; reject overlap with other recorded occupancy, meter gaps over 300 seconds, incomplete profiles, and cases without safe 15-minute slack.
cleaningAndTime.carbonUnits: EIA consumed-electricity intensity reported in lbs CO2/kWh; converted using 1 lb/kWh = 453.59237 kg/MWh.
cleaningAndTime.carbonAlignment: EIA UTC time marks the end of each hourly interval; map to the preceding UTC hour and repeat its intensity across four 15-minute slots. No interpolation.
cleaningAndTime.anonymization: Generated case/job IDs only; omit source job IDs, node IDs, user/account/script hashes, names, paths, and raw records.

limitations: The public job trace contains wallclock_req as a maximum runtime, not a contractual/user-provided completion deadline.
The 60-minute slack in these sensitivity cases is synthetic and cannot establish real SLA/deadline compliance.
EIA values are estimated balancing-authority consumption intensity, not data-center meter carbon or marginal emissions.
The sources contain no time-aligned site electricity price. Price/cost optimization is unavailable.
Power is whole-node iLO measurement. Per-job increments use a median-idle subtraction assumption, not causal per-job GPU power.
Cases independently move one job while holding other measured activity fixed; they are offline shadow counterfactuals, not a live Slurm integration or cluster-wide scheduler simulation.
